skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Strikes a single target with 2 combo hits, dealing 60% ATK DMG each, and increases own Speed% for 1 turn.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes each enemy in the entire row with 5 combo hits, dealing 28% ATK DMG each, and gains a [Tenacity] effect with power equal to 60% of max HP. Also has a 70% chance to inflict [Collapse] on hit targets for 2 turns (DMG reduction rate lowered by 30%).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes each enemy in the entire row with 5 combo hits, dealing 34% ATK DMG each, and gains a [Tenacity] effect with power equal to 65% of max HP. Also has an 80% chance to inflict [Collapse] on hit targets for 2 turns (DMG reduction rate lowered by 35%).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. When an enemy acts and its Speed is lower than his own, performs a [Follow-up] (attacking with 80% of the basic attack's DMG and effects, up to 3 times per turn). After an ally performs a follow-up, Flashy Flash deals 80% ATK extra DMG to all enemies, up to 3 times per turn.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. When an enemy acts and its Speed is lower than his own, performs a [Follow-up] (attacking with 80% of the basic attack's DMG and effects, up to 4 times per turn). After an ally performs a follow-up, Flashy Flash deals 90% ATK extra DMG to all enemies, up to 3 times per turn.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. When an enemy acts and its Speed is lower than his own, performs a [Follow-up] (attacking with 80% of the basic attack's DMG and effects, up to 4 times per turn). After an ally performs a follow-up, Flashy Flash deals 100% ATK extra DMG to all enemies, up to 3 times per turn.

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage over time and damage types (Damage, Internal Damage, Charge).
Extra attack outside of turn. Disabled by [Lock] and [Blind].
